delivery.activationGate: Keep discovery_mode=sweep-fallback until deployed evidence shows scheduler invocation recorded, triggered worker ran, outbox acknowledged delivery, and the ledger recorded trigger_source=trigger.
delivery.artifactRole: Durably commit SETUP_PENDING and ENTRY_CONFIRMED alert rows and expose the slim polling projection through getpaperpilotalerts; the artifact does not send chat messages.
delivery.deliverySemantics: Committed alerts remain recoverable in the ledger. Duplicate triggers are suppressed by signal_id + alert_type within the production or test ledger. Outbox acknowledgements reconcile attempts to delivered; ambiguous attempts reconcile to unknown, surface once, and are never auto-retried.

directTrigger.evidence: The deployed @hatch/space-sdk Ctx exposes agent, inference, tool, db, blobs, invalidateQueries and privileged execution, but no scheduler or cron.run capability. Action-side scheduler dispatch therefore cannot be compiled or deployed through the supported artifact API.

duplicate triggers must not duplicate notifications
committed alerts stay recoverable through the ledger
ambiguous sends reconcile to UNKNOWN and are never auto-retried
